# Scene

The Scene layer in the Excalidraw application is responsible for managing the rendering and exporting of scenes.

## Responsibilities

- Manages the rendering of elements on the canvas.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`packages/excalidraw/scene/Renderer.ts`](../../../packages/excalidraw/scene/Renderer.ts) | Exports Renderer class and its methods. | `Renderer` |
| [`packages/excalidraw/scene/export.ts`](../../../packages/excalidraw/scene/export.ts) | Exports export-related functions and constants. | `ExportSceneData`, `ExportSceneConfig`, `getExportConfigFromAppState`, `encodeSvgBase64Payload`, `decodeSvgBase64Payload`, `MIME_TYPES` |
| [`packages/excalidraw/scene/index.ts`](../../../packages/excalidraw/scene/index.ts) | Exports utility functions for scene management. | `isSomeElementSelected`, `getElementsWithinSelection`, `getSelectedElements`, `getTargetElements`, `getScrollToContentState`, `hasBackground` |
| [`packages/excalidraw/scene/normalize.ts`](../../../packages/excalidraw/scene/normalize.ts) | Exports functions for normalizing zoom and grid settings. | `getNormalizedZoom`, `getNormalizedGridSize`, `getNormalizedGridStep` |
| [`packages/excalidraw/scene/scrollbars.ts`](../../../packages/excalidraw/scene/scrollbars.ts) | Exports functions for managing scrollbars. | `SCROLLBAR_MARGIN`, `SCROLLBAR_WIDTH`, `SCROLLBAR_COLOR`, `getScrollBars`, `isOverScrollBars` |
| [`packages/excalidraw/scene/types.ts`](../../../packages/excalidraw/scene/types.ts) | Exports types and interfaces for scene rendering. | `RenderableElementsMap`, `StaticCanvasRenderConfig`, `SVGRenderConfig`, `InteractiveCanvasRenderConfig`, `RenderInteractiveSceneCallback`, `StaticSceneRenderConfig` |

## How it works

- **Renderer.ts**: Defines the `Renderer` class and its methods, which are used to render elements on the canvas.
- **normalize.ts**: Contains functions for normalizing zoom and grid settings to ensure consistent rendering.
- **scrollbars.ts**: Manages the rendering and interaction with scrollbars on the canvas.
- **types.ts**: Defines types and interfaces used for scene rendering, such as `RenderableElementsMap` and `SVGRenderConfig`.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `PROD`.
- Configuration files: `packages/excalidraw/tsconfig.json`.
